name: Curried Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Apple, Almonds & Raisins (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium red potato
½ lemon
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 stick celery
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Halve potato lengthwise, then cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer on one half of the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp Italian seasoning
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat, then transfer to the other half of the baking sheet, arranging the chicken in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g chicken thighs, boneless skinless
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, turning the chicken and potatoes halfway, until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a clean medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 tsp curry powder
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and medium dice one apple; add to the bowl. Quarter, core, and slice the remaining half apple into wedges and place on a plate.
Add half of both the almonds and raisins to the bowl. Add remaining almonds and raisins to the plate with the apple and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup almonds, sliced
⅓ cup raisins

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken and potatoes are done, thinly slice two thighs and set aside for the kid's plates. Roughly chop remaining chicken, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the curried chicken salad.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide sliced chicken, potatoes, apple slices, almonds, and raisins between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with curried chicken salad and enjoy!
